mission: Echo / Pusher synchronization deep test — READ-ONLY

verdict.headline: Echo/Pusher pipe is structurally sound end-to-end. F-SEC-W6-01 wildcard bypass closed (token-name discriminator), F-SEC-W6-02 Guest-Echo-Bypass closed (role check, not bare branch_id===0), 32/32 domain_events dispatched (pending=0, failed=0), Soketi LISTEN on 127.0.0.1:6001, broadcasting=pusher, healthz reports websocket=ok. KdsOrderRecalled wired tip-to-tail (event class + outbox listener + DispatchDomainEventsJob + eventContract BROADCAST_MAP + KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1934 subscriber). Adversarial probes return 401 on /api/broadcasting/auth without a valid Sanctum token; cross-branch leak prevented by routes/channels.php logic. Two documented P2/P3 caveats (healthz WS heuristic + cache-driver narrow guard) are accepted V1 backlog items, not ship blockers.

sec_findings_closed: F-SEC-W6-01: Sanctum [*] wildcard bypass via tokenCan('kiosk:order') — closed by token-NAME check
F-SEC-W6-02: Guest-Echo-Bypass via bare branch_id===0 — closed by hasRole() check

T2_ShouldBroadcast_inventory.approach_note: FoodKing migrated AWAY from ShouldBroadcast on Event classes. Pattern is now Outbox: plain domain Event -> PersistXxxToOutbox listener -> DomainEvent row (with channel + broadcast_as columns) -> DispatchDomainEventsJob -> BroadcastManager::connection()->broadcast(). Only legacy notification-flow events still implement ShouldBroadcast (SendOrder* / SendResetPassword / SendSmsCode).
T2_ShouldBroadcast_inventory.after_commit_pattern: All domain Events use the DispatchableAfterCommit trait (gate C9 / KI-001) so events are deferred until the surrounding DB::transaction() commits and DROPPED on rollback. Prevents the classic 'KDS sees an order that doesn't exist' race.

subscribing_surfaces: resources/js/components/admin/kitchenDisplaySystem/KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1900-1942 — KDS: OrderStatusChanged + OrderCreated + OrderPaidAtCounter + ItemAvailabilityChanged + OrderTableChanged + KdsOrderRecalled
T3_echo_subscribers_js.frontend_dedup: eventContract.js maintains a 2048-slot LRU+TTL (10 min) correlation-id set, persisted to sessionStorage with debounced flush (250ms) + synchronous pagehide flush. Drops duplicate broadcasts from worker race or replay BEFORE handlers fire.
T3_echo_subscribers_js.envelope_validation: validateEnvelope() enforces version=1, type=string, payload=object. Mismatched broadcastAs vs payload.type triggers console.warn. Producer side uses EventContract::assertEnvelopeValid before broadcast and PayloadMismatchException short-circuits with $this->fail() (no 6-retry storm on contract violation).

T4_broadcasting_config.frontend_bootstrap: resources/js/bootstrap.js:293-394 — Echo instance with Bearer token auth (NOT cookie/session), subscription_error handler refreshes token via window._refreshEchoAuth then bubbles to wsService.handleSubscriptionError (F-12 sliding-window 3-failures-in-60s -> SESSION_INVALID).
T4_broadcasting_config.polling_fallback: Per-surface intentional divergence (config/broadcasting.php block comment):  POS=30000ms (MIX_BROADCAST_POLLING_FALLBACK_MS), KDS=5000ms WS-down / 60000ms WS-up, Kiosk=15000ms (always). Documented as V1.0.2 SoT-wire backlog item (RED-Z3 §B-6).

T5_branch_isolation.isolation_proof: Channel auth callback in routes/channels.php:41-62 explicitly rejects when staff $user->branch_id != $branchId and they are not Admin/Tenant Admin. Kiosk-token branch is locked to its KioskMachine row's branch_id (verified line 49). No customer-token can subscribe to any branch.* channel (no role + branch_id=0 default).
T5_branch_isolation.model_branch_scope_check: 20 models locked under BranchScope (per CLAUDE.md §9) — sentinel BranchScopeCoverageSentinelTest. Echo channel auth + BranchScope = double defense.

T6_KdsOrderRecalled_HEAL5_verification.listener: app/Listeners/PersistKdsOrderRecalledToOutbox.php — idempotent by sha1(KDS_ORDER_RECALLED|orderId|recalledAt|correlationId), persists with channel='private-branch.{branchId}' broadcast_as='KdsOrderRecalled'
T6_KdsOrderRecalled_HEAL5_verification.dispatcher: app/Jobs/DispatchDomainEventsJob.php — atomic lockForUpdate claim + dispatched_at guard, backoff [1,5,15,60,300]s, tries=6, refuses to dispatch on PayloadMismatchException ($this->fail())
T6_KdsOrderRecalled_HEAL5_verification.broadcast_log_evidence: storage/logs/laravel.log: 4 occurrences of 'Broadcasting [KdsOrderRecalled] on channels [private-branch.1]' on 2026-05-26 (PHPUnit testing.INFO driver)
T6_KdsOrderRecalled_HEAL5_verification.i18n_keys_present: Verified by HEAL-5 own sentinel tasks 117-118
T6_KdsOrderRecalled_HEAL5_verification.non_replay_to_customer: Comment confirms recall is INTERNAL KDS only — does NOT reuse OrderStatusChanged so customer Mail/Sms/Push listeners are NOT re-fired (prevents 'Prêt' -> 'Annulé' -> 'Prêt' notification storm).

T7_curl_healthz.ws_check_interpretation: websocket=ok confirms BROADCAST_DRIVER!=null AND PUSHER_HOST configured. Note: V1 LOCAL heuristic is INTENTIONALLY shallow (config + env check, no live TCP probe). Independent validation via lsof -iTCP:6001 confirms Soketi PID 50733 is actually LISTENING (corroborates the heuristic).
T7_curl_healthz.fiscal_chain_fail_note: Out of H1 scope — separate audit chain issue tracked elsewhere. Does NOT affect Echo pipe.

T8_log_tail_broadcast_events.interpretation: testing.INFO entries are from the PHPUnit run that confirmed HEAL-5 backend (BROADCAST_DRIVER=log in tests). They prove the event is being dispatched correctly through Laravel's BroadcastManager. Production driver=pusher routes them to Soketi instead, with the same channel + name.

T9_domain_events_db.kds_recall_db_zero_explained: Dev DB has 0 kds.order_recalled rows because all 4 recall broadcasts logged were against the testing in-memory DB (laravel.log shows testing.INFO driver). HEAL-5 wiring is structurally complete; runtime broadcast just hasn't been exercised against the dev DB in production driver mode. NOT a defect.
T9_domain_events_db.observability_note: DispatchDomainEventsJob stamps Cache::put('ws:heartbeat', now()->timestamp, 120) on every successful broadcast — feeds the admin observability page (SyncOverviewController:531) so 'pusher up but silent' dashboards don't lie.

T10_PII_payload_audit.pii_check: NO customer_name, NO email, NO phone, NO address, NO card number, NO cardholder name, NO Stripe payment_intent_id in any broadcast payload. The `token` field on OrderStatusChanged is the order's short-slug OSS-lookup identifier (NOT a credential, NOT a Sanctum token). The `actor_id` on KdsOrderRecalled is the staff user_id of the chef who recalled — already visible to other chefs on the same branch (legitimate audit trail).
T10_PII_payload_audit.verdict: NO PII leak in broadcasted payloads. Channels are bound to private-branch.{id} so only authorized staff/kiosk on the same branch receive them. Customer-facing data (name/email) is fetched via authenticated REST when needed, never broadcast.

A10_cross_branch_leak_attempt.scenario: Admin (branch_id=0) vs staff (branch_id=1) vs staff (branch_id=2) subscribing to private-branch.1
A10_cross_branch_leak_attempt.live_probe: POST /api/broadcasting/auth without valid Sanctum bearer = 401 Unauthenticated (3/3 probes). Without valid token, the closure is never even invoked.
A10_cross_branch_leak_attempt.status: CLOSED — defense layered: middleware auth:sanctum + closure logic + BranchScope on KioskMachine query

A11_wildcard_escalation.scenario: Admin/staff token with abilities=['*'] (wildcard) subscribing to ANY branch — historic F-SEC-W6-01
A11_wildcard_escalation.old_bug: tokenCan('kiosk:order') returned TRUE because Sanctum's PersonalAccessToken::can() short-circuits to TRUE when '*' is in abilities; admin tokens routed through the kiosk-branch clause and were silently denied — real KDS lost real-time push.
A11_wildcard_escalation.heal_applied: Switched to $user->currentAccessToken()?->name === 'kiosk-token' (token NAME is set at mint time by KioskMachineLoginController:99 and CANNOT be tampered by ability wildcards).

A12_replay_attack.scenario: Attacker intercepts a Pusher message envelope and re-broadcasts it (or a worker re-fires the queue job).
A12_replay_attack.defense_layer_1: Backend: DispatchDomainEventsJob:65-86 wraps the broadcast in a transaction with lockForUpdate + dispatched_at IS NULL guard. Two workers racing on the same DomainEvent row: only ONE wins the claim, the other returns silently. No double broadcast.
A12_replay_attack.defense_layer_2: Frontend: eventContract.js maintains a 2048-slot dedupe set keyed by (event_type, branch_id, correlation_id), persisted to sessionStorage with 10-minute TTL. Duplicate envelopes are dropped BEFORE component handlers fire — no UI toast spam, no double cart prune.
A12_replay_attack.defense_layer_3: Listeners are idempotent by content-hash (sha1 of event_type|order_id|old_status|new_status|correlation_id). UNIQUE INDEX on domain_events.idempotency_key prevents double-insert in PersistXxxToOutbox path even on listener replay.
A12_replay_attack.status: CLOSED — triple defense (DB unique + worker claim + client dedupe)

A13_soketi_down_polling_fallback.scenario: Soketi crashes — does every surface degrade gracefully?
A13_soketi_down_polling_fallback.POS: MIX_BROADCAST_POLLING_FALLBACK_MS=30000 (30s polling). Source: posOrder.js:59-64. Stale by ≤30s.
A13_soketi_down_polling_fallback.KDS: Adaptive cadence in KdsSyncService.js + KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1759-1761. WS-down=5000ms (5s), WS-up=60000ms (drift-check only). On wsService.reconnect_storm event, immediate forceSync with 0-500ms jitter (anti-thundering-herd).
A13_soketi_down_polling_fallback.Kiosk: KioskWaitingComponent.vue:183 POLL_INTERVAL_MS=15000 (15s) — always-on polling, Echo is a freshness bonus.
A13_soketi_down_polling_fallback.wsService_circuit_breaker: 4 disconnects in 30s -> opens breaker for 5-30s (AWS decorrelated jitter) -> single reconnect attempt. Protects against thundering-herd when Soketi restarts.
A13_soketi_down_polling_fallback.owner_impact_estimate: If Soketi down: real-time push 1s -> polling fallback {30s POS / 5s KDS / 15s Kiosk}. UX degrades but UI stays alive. Kitchen can still bump tickets, customer still sees Prêt eventually. No data loss, no fiscal impact, no NF525 chain disturbance.
A13_soketi_down_polling_fallback.status: RESILIENT — all 3 surfaces have polling fallback + adaptive cadence; HealthCheck does NOT block POS sales when WS is down.

A14_PII_leak_in_OrderStatusChanged.scenario: Does the payload contain customer PII that leaks across the branch's staff/kiosk Echo subscribers?
A14_PII_leak_in_OrderStatusChanged.payload_audit_result: NO PII (see T10_PII_payload_audit). Order ID + queue number + payment status + token (short slug) only. Customer name/email/phone is NEVER broadcast.

A15_owner_impact_if_Echo_breaks.scenario: Owner asks: 'What happens to my restaurant if the WebSocket pipe dies during dinner rush?'
A15_owner_impact_if_Echo_breaks.answer: Sync latency degrades from ~1s (live) to per-surface polling cadence (5s KDS, 15s Kiosk, 30s POS). UX feel: noticeably less snappy but functional. No order is lost, no payment fails, NF525 audit chain unaffected. Polling is fail-safe: KDS still sees new orders within 5s, customer still sees 'Prêt' within 15s. Admin observability dashboard (SyncOverviewController) shows 'websockets_serve: down' so OPS knows to restart Soketi. Cron rescue (outbox:retry-failed) re-attempts any swallowed broadcast within 1 min.
A15_owner_impact_if_Echo_breaks.fiscal_safety: DispatchableAfterCommit guarantees event is dropped on rollback — there can never be a 'KDS sees order X but DB has no order X' state, regardless of WS state.
A15_owner_impact_if_Echo_breaks.verdict: GRACEFUL DEGRADATION — V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne is Echo-resilient by design.

p2_p3_documented_caveats.title: healthz websocket=ok is heuristic (not a live TCP probe)
p2_p3_documented_caveats.details: HealthzController::checkWebsocket only validates that PUSHER_HOST is set and broadcasting driver != null. A Soketi that crashed AFTER boot would still report websocket=ok until /api/admin/observability/sync (SyncOverviewController) is hit and the ws:heartbeat cache stale-age check trips. Trade-off accepted per Phase A.1 mandate (V1 LOCAL — admin dashboard provides the strict gate; /healthz is the lenient public probe).
p2_p3_documented_caveats.backlog_ref: V1.0.X cloud-prep — add TCP socket probe to PUSHER_HOST:PUSHER_PORT

p2_p3_documented_caveats.title: Cache driver guard at AppServiceProvider:215 covers array/null only (file/database PASS)
p2_p3_documented_caveats.details: Already documented in CLAUDE.md §8 NF525 section as UNI-03. Independent verification 2026-05-21 confirmed file driver passes the guard despite block comment saying 'redis or memcached'. V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne single-box file driver is safe (no cross-worker coherence problem); ALB multi-instance cloud rollout requires widening the list. NOT an Echo bug per se, but the Cache::lock that DispatchDomainEventsJob uses indirectly depends on this — flagging here for completeness.

p2_p3_documented_caveats.title: Per-surface polling cadence is NOT config-driven (intentional divergence)
p2_p3_documented_caveats.details: POS=30s, KDS=5/60s, Kiosk=15s are hardcoded in 3 different files. RED-Z3 §B-6 documented this as deliberate operator-density vs kitchen-staleness vs UX-wait tradeoffs. V1 LOCAL ships with documented divergence; SSOT wire is V1.0.2 backlog.

p2_p3_documented_caveats.title: eventContract dedupe is sessionStorage-per-tab (not cross-tab)
p2_p3_documented_caveats.details: Already documented in eventContract.js comment block (Audit G5/G6/G7 info-level). FIFO not strict LRU; events without correlation_id bypass dedupe entirely (V1 contract enforces correlation_id is always set). Cross-tab BroadcastChannel + localStorage SSOT out of scope V1.

sentinel_results.BroadcastDriverConfiguredTest: PASS (default driver = pusher, not log/null in prod-mode)

sync_mesh_integrity.kiosk_to_kds_path: KioskOrderController -> OrderCreated(after commit) -> PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox -> DomainEvent row (channel=private-branch.{branchId}, broadcast_as=OrderCreated) -> DispatchDomainEventsJob (high queue) -> BroadcastManager(pusher) -> Soketi -> Echo subscribers (KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue + KioskWaitingComponent.vue + PreparingAndReadyComponent.vue)
sync_mesh_integrity.kds_recall_path: KdsRecallController -> KdsOrderRecalled -> PersistKdsOrderRecalledToOutbox -> DomainEvent row -> DispatchDomainEventsJob -> BroadcastManager(pusher) -> Soketi -> Echo subscriber (KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1934 only — internal KDS, NOT customer notification stream)
sync_mesh_integrity.catalog_change_path: ItemAvailabilityController -> ItemAvailabilityChanged + CatalogChanged -> PersistXxxToOutbox -> DispatchDomainEventsJob -> BroadcastManager(pusher) -> Soketi -> Echo subscribers (StockRuptureDashboardComponent.vue + KioskAppComponent.vue cache-bust + KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1919)
sync_mesh_integrity.after_commit_guarantee: DispatchableAfterCommit trait on all domain events ensures broadcast NEVER fires before DB commit (drops on rollback). Closes the classic 'broadcast-before-commit' race.
sync_mesh_integrity.idempotency_guarantee: Triple-layer: (1) UNIQUE INDEX on domain_events.idempotency_key, (2) lockForUpdate + dispatched_at IS NULL claim in DispatchDomainEventsJob, (3) frontend correlation-id dedupe with sessionStorage persistence. Each layer is independently sufficient.
sync_mesh_integrity.branch_isolation_guarantee: Channel is always private-branch.{order.branch_id} from the listener side, and routes/channels.php enforces ('staff branch_id match' OR 'role=Admin/Tenant Admin' OR 'kiosk-token name match + machine branch_id match'). No leak path identified.
sync_mesh_integrity.overall_mesh_verdict: INTACT — no broken edges, no missing subscribers, no orphaned producers. Outbox pattern + AfterCommit + Triple-Idempotency + Branch-Channel-Auth form a production-grade cross-surface sync mesh for V1 LOCAL.

verdict_summary.recommendation: NO HEAL REQUIRED for Echo system. Continue cycle. Two P2 (healthz heuristic, cache-driver guard) and two P3 (per-surface cadence SSOT, cross-tab dedupe) caveats are accepted V1.0.X backlog items.
